verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting based on the Paris prosecutors office confirms that Jean-Luc Brunel was detained at Charles de Gaulle Airport on December 16, 2020 as part of an investigation covering rape, sexual assault of minors, sexual harassment, criminal association, and trafficking or exploitation of minors. Later formal charges were narrower, so this result verifies the scope of the investigation at custody rather than implying conviction or formal charge on every listed offense.
